articles.summary: After 5+ years, Wasp 1.0 is officially in the works. Learn why we stayed pre-1.0 so long, what changed, and what you can expect from 1.0.
articles.title: Wasp 1.0 is coming

articles.summary: Wasp 0.26 makes it easy for agents to work on different tasks in your Wasp project at the same time using Git worktrees. You can now have your orchestrator run multiple worktrees and agents, each using wasp start and wasp start db without stepping on each other's toes.
articles.title: Wasp Is Now Friendlier To AI Agents

articles.summary: Wasp 0.26 gives each app its own set of ports, so each coding agent can run your app in its own Git worktree. It also adds wasp show.
articles.title: Wasp 0.26: parallel worktrees, wasp show, docs updates, and safer auth defaults
